Annotations.Caption:
Used for viewing (historical) workflows, for example in the 'My initiated workflows' page. Kept up to date with System.Workflow on basis of state change events.

This 'carbon copy' of the System.Workflow is introduced because from 9.10 onwards, users only have access to 'In progress' tasks and workflows, and are therefore not able to see 'Completed' workflows, or 'In progress' workflows which do not have any 'In progress' user task targeted/assigned to them.
Used for viewing (historical) user tasks, for example in the task dashboard (to view completed tasks) and the timeline snippets. See explanation above.

DEPRECATED. Assignees are now a reference set. Therefore, please use the 'UserTaskView_Assignees' association instead. If you have any existing user tasks that use this deprecated association, execute the migration microflow 'ACT_Assignee_Migration' (also added to the 'WorkflowAdminCenter' page) or add the 'ASu_Assignee_Migrate' microflow to the project's after startup microflow to transfer to the new association 'UserTaskView_Assignees'.
The WorkflowKey attribute uniquely identifies the workflow instance. The value is helpful for correlating audit trail data to the related workflow.
The TaskKey attribute uniquely identifies the user task instance. The value is helpful for correlating audit trail data to the related user task.
